**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/02/26 (Sun) 19:03
- [EVENT] User is trying to calculate savings on a laundry detergent purchase.
- [FACT] User assumes the original price of the laundry detergent is $10 for calculation purposes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant is happy to help calculate savings on the laundry detergent purchase.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To calculate savings, assistant needs the original price and the discount or sale price.
- [FACT] User received 20% off the laundry detergent at Target.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] With 20% off, user paid 80% of the original price.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Original price = $10, Discount = 20% of $10 = $2.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sale price = Original price - Discount = $10 - $2 = $8.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User paid $8 for the laundry detergent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Savings = Original price - Sale price = $10 - $8 = $2.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User saved $2 on the laundry detergent.
- [FACT] User confirms the savings calculation is correct.
- [EVENT] User has a $2 off coupon on Tide laundry detergent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sale price (after 20% discount) = $8, Coupon value = $2.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] New price after applying coupon = Sale price - Coupon value = $8 - $2 = $6.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] After applying the $2 off coupon, user will pay $6 for the Tide laundry detergent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Total savings = Original price - New price = $10 - $6 = $4.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User has saved a total of $4 on the laundry detergent.
- [FACT] User wants to calculate total savings on all household essentials including laundry detergent, toilet paper, and paper towels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant is happy to help calculate total savings on all household essentials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant asks for details on toilet paper and paper towels to calculate total savings.
